_comment: Symbols shown in the rolling header ticker, per exchange.
NSE is fetched as a live 'most active by volume' list, so it needs no watchlist -
whatever the market is actually trading that day shows up.
BSE has no open bulk-quote endpoint, only a per-scrip one, so it needs an explicit
list. Keep it short: every entry is one HTTP request per refresh.
MCX contracts expire monthly, hence the symbol root plus expiry-agnostic matching.
